gaps.valueSet: Rules 4 and 5 acute-onset qualifier on jaundice diagnoses or active problems
gaps.reason: SEM_V1 diagnoses and problems do not carry qualifier value-set OIDs, so the required Acute Onset [Qualifier Value] relationship cannot be evaluated; both rules are omitted rather than treating the qualifier as an unrelated diagnosis

gaps.valueSet: Rules 4 and 6 contact with a laboratory-confirmed hepatitis A case 15-50 days before symptom onset
gaps.reason: the authoritative source marks both rules inoperable because the epidemiologic contact criterion has no codes; SEM_V1 also carries neither contact history nor onset-relative timing, so both rules are omitted rather than allowing jaundice or nonspecific symptoms alone to report
SEM_V1 has no vital-sign numeric comparison for temperature at least 38.9 degC or 102.0 degF; the entire rule is already omitted because its required epidemiologic criterion is unavailable
